owner_approval: 2026-08-21 conversation: after receiving the proposed dense -> compression -> direction -> release redesign, owner explicitly replied '去做啊'. This authorizes the four-component factor as one recorded composite research variable. It does not authorize holdout reuse, barrier changes, model training, promotion, deployment or live trading.
question: Can a causal six-MA dense-start gate remove short-lived false starts while preserving the rare ETH 15m trend runners better than frozen V12F?

single_composite_variable.baseline: frozen V12F full-state MA6-W8 net-cross gate
unchanged: EMA100 regime and EMA200 slope-12 direction
ATR14 x4 initial stop capped at 3 percent
1.5 percent break-even trigger and 0.1 percent offset
1 percent risk sizing and 13x leverage cap
calendar filters, cooldown, reversal semantics and 20bp cost

causal_sequence.density: all 15 unordered pair order flips summed over [t-12,t-1]; the release bar t is excluded
causal_sequence.compression: mean over [t-12,t-1] of (max six MA - min six MA) / ATR14
causal_sequence.direction: side-aligned 12 cross-period net crosses over [t-12,t-1] plus current t fast-vs-slow alignment out of 12; same-period SMA/EMA pairs have no invented direction
causal_sequence.release: close[t] outside the current six-MA rope, side-aligned mean six-MA slope over t-3..t positive, and either slope coherence or ATR14 expansion passes
causal_sequence.feature_visibility: every feature at t uses bars <= t; entry remains open[t+1]

release_boolean: price_breakout AND signed_mean_slope_atr > 0 AND (slope_coherence >= profile minimum OR atr_release_ratio >= profile minimum)

ranking: maximize the worse 2023 half-year compounded return
then maximize the worse 2023 half-year project-net bp per trade
then maximize the worse 2023 half-year win rate
then minimize the maximum 2023 half-year drawdown
then prefer the less strict profile by profile order
selection_contract.fail_closed: if no profile has at least 10 trades in each 2023 half, select no V13 profile

locked_evaluation_order: evaluate the locked profile on 2024H1/2024H2 and calendar 2024
only then describe the already-consumed final-preholdout 2025-01 through 2026-02 segment

acceptance.economic_gate: selected V13 must have positive top-decile net return with permutation p < 0.01 and positive matched-control excess; otherwise it remains rejected/paper-only
mechanism_checks: fewer stop exits within 24 hours than V12F
higher net win rate than V12F
rare multi-day trend winners are not all removed
regardless_of_result: forward_eligible=false until a genuinely new forward protocol is separately approved
official TradingView trade-export parity remains required

future_lr_interface.blocker: repository P0/P1 gate forbids new LR/LightGBM training
